We welcome collaborators, especially researchers using AI in sciences beyond
climate and Earth system science, and anyone with an error story to share.
Each button opens an email with a few prompts filled in.

## Keep me posted

Hear about news and the February 2027 call by email.

<span class="email-obfuscate" data-user="contact" data-domain="productive-error.org" data-subject="Add me to the Productive Error email list" data-body="Please add me to the Productive Error email list.|Name:|Affiliation (optional):|Most interested in (the workshop, findings, or both):" data-label="Keep me posted" data-class="button button-secondary">contact [at] productive-error.org</span>

## Share an error story

Tell us about a time an AI-driven model went wrong: what happened, how it was
found, and what it taught you.

Writing to us starts a conversation, nothing more. We won't quote, publish
or use your story in our research without asking you first. If it fits the
project, we may invite you to an interview, which is voluntary and
confidential.

<span class="email-obfuscate" data-user="contact" data-domain="productive-error.org" data-subject="I have an error story to share" data-body="What model or tool was involved:|What went wrong:|How it was found:|What it taught you or your team:|Best way to reach you:" data-label="Share an error story" data-class="button button-secondary">contact [at] productive-error.org</span>

## Workshop

The workshop is in New York City in fall 2027, and the call for extended
abstracts and speakers goes out in February 2027. See the
[Workshop](workshop.qmd) page.
